matching.unit: one exact lexical absolute path; symlink, alias, parent, sibling, and descendant worktree exceptions are not implicit

explicit_nonparticipant_surfaces: companion Mac and every human-facing application
stock Codex and Claude sessions on every host
tmux, interactive shells, and general agent processes
operational_constraints: Before C1 there are no human participants and no model endpoints; only P1-frozen machine executables inside ai-vps-controlled-harness may consume cohort bytes.
The protocol checkout is exact-P1 and read-only; all private writes occur inside the explicit private harness root through frozen executables.
Content from any filesystem path, network response, API, tool, control request, or generated artifact must cross the healthy signed broker before reaching a machine participant.
No participant may continue while the broker heartbeat, signing key, isolation boundary, or immutable content store is unavailable.

Mac, humans, stock Codex and Claude, tmux, general VPS sessions, agent-sync, and the local relay are outside only while zero filesystem, socket, process-memory, credential, environment, network, model-context, and control-input ingress is proved.
Any possible unregistered ingress into a participant is PROTOCOL_INVALID; UNKNOWN is not a cure for a missing ingress record.
After C1, each arm or verifier receives a fresh isolated process or model context with no inherited session, memory, cache, prior-arm result, or shared writable state.
